method: local offset between the plan and z16 satellite imagery, measured by FFT cross-correlation at 168 sample points across the sheet (tools/measure_hires_fft.py)
what_it_measures: the difference between where the plan's content sits and where the same content sits in satellite imagery
caveat: The plan was drawn from an older base map than the satellite imagery, so most of this offset is the base map's age, not the georeference. A linear field explains only 4% of the variance, and the offset does not grow with distance from the sheet centre - both signs that there is no large correctable scale error.
